summary: Lake County, CA peak in Mendocino NF; a forest ranger lookout was in use by 1925 (F.H. Runk in charge); FFLA lists it gone and no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: FFLA lists the lookout as gone; no source describes what, if anything, stands on the summit now

events.note: F.H. Runk in charge of the forest rangers lookout on Elk Mountain (Ukiah Republican Press, 11 Nov 1925, as quoted by Forest Lookouts)

evidence.supports: forest rangers lookout on Elk Mountain in November 1925; F.H. Runk in charge
evidence.quote: F.H. Runk, who has charge of the forest rangers lookout on Elk Mountain was a Ukiah business visitor during the week.
Elk Mountain is a 4,191-foot-high (1,277 m) mountain in Lake County

evidence.supports: about 10 miles north of Upper Lake
evidence.quote: is about 10 mi (16 km) north of Upper Lake

evidence.supports: mountain is within Mendocino National Forest
evidence.quote: It is in Mendocino National Forest in Lake County, California.

evidence.supports: Elk Mountain Road is a dirt national forest road passing about 1 km east of the mountain
evidence.quote: The Elk Mountain Road (National Forest Route M1) is a dirt road

evidence.supports: road passes about 1 km east of Elk Mountain
evidence.quote: It passes about 1 km (0.62 mi) to the east of Elk Mountain.

evidence.supports: FFLA lists the Elk Mountain lookout as Gone, type Unknown

notes_for_editor: Only one dated source places a lookout here: a 1925 newspaper line quoted on Forest Lookouts. No build date, design, height or fate beyond the FFLA 'Gone' entry was found. The mountain is not on the FFLOS California index in our cache, so there is no register entry. Record kind 'unknown' and FFLA type 'Unknown' are both left unchanged. Nothing here changes the record.
